<teammate-message teammate_id="team-lead">
Repo: /home/phili/tools/cavecrew-mcp. Review the UNCOMMITTED diff of cave/skills.js (git diff cave/skills.js). Context: three chop bug fixes just made:
B) iterations++ moved so quarantine/no-go/non-tree skips no longer consume the count*4+20 chop budget; new HARD_LOOP_CAP=500 on total loop passes.
A) chopOrigin captured before ensureTool(axe); if ensureTool walked bot >8 blocks away, goto back via existing gotoLoop/GoalNear helper; goto fail = warn + continue.
C) ensurePlanksAndSticks: hard floor 5 split into PLANK_MIN=3 (gates the throw) vs PLANK_BUFFER=5 (soft top-up only when logs on hand or below MIN) so a mid-chain second tool craft with exactly 3 planks + 2 sticks proceeds instead of throwing "could not gather any logs for planks".

Hunt: correctness bugs, infinite-loop risk (loop bounded ONLY if every skip adds a NEW skippedKeys entry — verify findBlock matcher really excludes skipped keys and nothing resets the set), off-by-one on iteration counting vs maxIterations semantics, chopOrigin return-goto edge cases (goto helper signature right? ctx/cancel plumbed?), ensurePlanksAndSticks regression risk for the bare-bootstrap case (0 planks 0 logs must still throw/punch-bootstrap same as before — UngaBunga death-fix must survive), stick-count handling (2 sticks needed per tool — is stick floor also checked or can planks pass but sticks starve?), and any interaction with punchLogsBareHand grove exception. Rank findings by severity, note file:line. Verdict: SHIP / FIX FIRST. Caveman style.
</teammate-message>

content.text:
Me read diff + surrounding code. Findings:

BAD ROCK cave/skills.js:2402-2418 — plank floor ignores stick cost, and gather gate skips log hunt when planks already at MIN. Stick craft eats 2 planks AFTER plank check passed. Fail story: bot has 3 planks, 0 sticks, 0 logs, trees nearby → line 2402 `!log && planks.count < PLANK_MIN` = false (3<3), gather SKIPPED (old code gathered here, succeeded) → plank floor passes (3≥3) → line 2418 `craftLocal(bot, 'stick', 1, ctx)` consumes 2 planks → 1 plank + 4 sticks → `ensurePlanksAndSticks` returns true → `craftWithTable('wooden_pickaxe')` at 2490 finds no recipe, throws "missing ingredients". Same for 4 planks + 1 stick. Old code success → new code hard fail. Real min = 3 planks + (sticks<2 ? 2 more : 0). This re-breaks exact craft chain fix targeted.

BAD ROCK cave/skills.js:1163-1166 — HARD_LOOP_CAP throw discards partial results. Fail story: wooded no-go zone within 48 blocks holds >480 log blocks (each = 1 skip pass at 1209, ~80 trees enough) → bot chops 3 real trees first, then skip passes push loopPasses over 500 → throw at 1165 → caller loses `{chopped: 3, trees, collected}`, late-drop sweep at 1321 never runs, driver marks whole task failed despite real work done. Old code broke gracefully + returned partials. Cap should `break` + warn, not throw. Also cap check sits BEFORE `ctx.isCancelled?.()` — cancelled task at pass 501 dies with "matcher likely stuck" error instead of clean cancel.

BAD PEBBLE cave/skills.js:2403 — second `(!planks || planks.count < PLANK_MIN)` after `ensureLogs` reads STALE `planks` var, never re-fetched. Branch only entered when condition already true → recheck ALWAYS true → dead code. Fail story: `ensureLogs` chop sweep collects stray plank drops → inventory now fine → still throws "could not gather any logs for planks" because var stale. Intended escape never fires.

Me verified rest — no break:
- Loop terminates without iterations++ on skips: every skip path (1199, 1210, 1216, 1284, 1299, 1312) adds NEW key — findBlock just returned block so key not in set yet; matcher at 1181 excludes skippedKeys + handles null-position palette probe. Sound.
- maxIterations off-by-one: none. `iterations < maxIterations` at top + increment at 1224 = exactly count*4+20 real attempts.
- chopOrigin: captured before ensureTool ✓, `gotoLoop(bot, goal, opts, ctx)` signature matches 523 ✓, `goals.GoalNear` ✓, goto fail = warn + continue ✓, whole thing inside `!opts._skipEnsureTool` guard so ensureLogs recursion untouched ✓.
- Bare bootstrap preserved: 0 planks 0 logs → 2402 both true → `ensureLogs` punch bootstrap → same throw on fail. UngaBunga fix survives.
- Grove exception in punchLogsBareHand (2324) + chopTrees quarantine (1198) untouched, consistent.

VERDICT: 3 real problems. Worst: plank-min gate blind to stick cost — 3-4 planks + <2 sticks + no logs turns old success into craft-chain hard fail. FIX FIRST.
